name: Sagittarius A*
blurb: Sagittarius A* sits at the center of our galaxy — a supermassive black hole about four million times the mass of the Sun, revealed by stellar orbits and the Event Horizon Telescope.
highlights: Milky Way’s central supermassive black hole
Roughly 26,000 light-years toward the constellation Sagittarius
